Keep data boundaries close to the content

The reference application's services page supplies search, filters, and actions
to its shell and places Suspense and error boundaries around independently
loading content. This allows one section to recover while the page chrome and
other controls remain usable. The layout library supplies composition and
validation; your query library and router drive data states.
